functions.functionName: Create UDS and UDW State for Saving · 𝖴𝖣𝖲
functions.description: Outputs the state of dynamics like time and weather, to be saved with a save file or between levels. To load the data, use the function "Apply Saved UDS and UDW State". Note, this function doesn't pack together every single variable on the blueprints, only the typical dynamic ones which would make sense to include in save data.
